design_notes: This is a product agent contract. It does not require exposure as a top-level host subagent unless isolated context materially improves the product and host tests prove the configuration works.
evidence_prohibited: Hidden model memory as proof of target state.
Any evidence produced by unauthorized mutation.
evidence_required: Only evidence explicitly provided or retrieved through the active run plan.
Every target-specific fact carries a stable evidence ID and target identity.
Platform guidance uses governed SfSkills knowledge or a current official source.
host_exposure_rationale: Commands are the stable user surface. Expose this role as a host subagent only when isolated context materially improves quality and host smoke tests prove tool and policy behavior.
inputs: Validated `review-security-posture` input, selected knowledge manifest, normalized evidence, optional project inspection, and declared unknowns
outputs: Structured Security Posture Review findings, claim/evidence graph, recommendations, status proposal, and review-ready draft
prompt_principles: Separate facts, inferences, recommendations, and unknowns explicitly.
Prefer a smaller evidence-backed answer over a broad plausible answer.
Never use hidden model memory as proof of target state.
Preserve contradictions and lower confidence rather than resolving them rhetorically.
Return structured handoffs and never forward full subagent transcripts.
purpose: Own Security Posture Review synthesis: Assess a Salesforce scope for evidence-backed access, code, session, integration, data, and configuration risks, prioritized by exploitability and business impact.
success_criteria: No security claim without evidence and scope
Policy versus platform finding is distinguished
